entities.name: PNPLA3
observations: PNPLA3 expression is detectable in human subcutaneous adipose tissue; expression increased significantly six months after laparoscopic gastric banding in 28 severely obese patients.

entities.name: PMID:27514759
observations: In 28 severely obese patients, subcutaneous adipose and liver samples were assessed before and six months after laparoscopic gastric banding by qRT-PCR; adipose PNPLA3 increased significantly, hepatic PNPLA3 did not.

entities.name: Post-LAGB adipose PNPLA3 increase
observations: In 28 severely obese patients, subcutaneous adipose PNPLA3 mRNA increased significantly six months after laparoscopic gastric banding; the abstract does not establish normalization against lean controls or provide an effect size.
